name: Flowise
tagline: Drag-and-drop visual builder for creating local LLM chains, document loaders, and agent workflows.
real_test_summary: Tested wiring a local embedding model, vector store, and local LLM node on the visual canvas for offline document chat. Exposes an API endpoint once the flow is saved.
pros: Intuitive node canvas for rapid local RAG and agent prototyping
Runs locally with Node.js or Docker and connects to local LLMs
Exports workflows as APIs for external apps or scripts
cons: Large visual graphs can get crowded without sub-flows
Requires basic familiarity with embeddings and vector stores
